name: Office
description: Read and edit live Word paragraphs, Excel cells and PowerPoint text with ONLYOFFICE, then save back to Files.

actions.name: skill
actions.description: Read the Office agent guide and examples.

actions.name: interface
actions.description: Discover Office actions and live editor capability/status.

actions.name: open
actions.description: Start opening an Office file; read status until ready. Save pending edits first.

actions.name: save
actions.description: Save current changes to the original Files location; browser uploads download a copy.

actions.name: download
actions.description: Download a separate copy of the current document.

actions.name: reload
actions.description: Reconnect a saved Office document; read status until ready.

actions.name: word_read
actions.description: Read live Word paragraphs, including table-cell paragraphs, with stable IDs and text.

actions.name: word_replace_text
actions.description: Replace one uniquely matching text fragment inside one paragraph, preserving surrounding content. Does not save to Files.

params.session_id: Required session_id from a fresh read; binds the edit to this document
params.paragraph_id: Exact paragraph id returned by word_read or slides_read
params.expected_text: Exact previous paragraph text; rejects concurrent changes
params.find: Case-sensitive single-line fragment; must occur exactly once
params.replacement: Replacement text; empty string deletes the match

actions.name: word_insert_paragraph
actions.description: Insert one paragraph before or after a checked paragraph.

params.session_id: Required session_id from a fresh read; binds the edit to this document
params.paragraph_id: Exact paragraph id returned by word_read or slides_read
params.expected_text: Exact previous paragraph text; rejects concurrent changes

actions.name: word_format_paragraph
actions.description: Apply basic text formatting to a checked paragraph.

params.session_id: Required session_id from a fresh read; binds the edit to this document
params.paragraph_id: Exact paragraph id returned by word_read or slides_read
params.expected_text: Exact previous paragraph text; rejects concurrent changes
params.format: Object: optional bold/italic booleans and font_size (1–200 points)

actions.name: sheets_list
actions.description: List live worksheets and their names and indices.

actions.name: sheets_read_range
actions.description: Read values and formulas for every cell in a bounded range. Returns cells for the next write guard.

params.range: Bounded A1 range, e.g. A1:C20; at most 1000 cells

actions.name: sheets_write_range
actions.description: Update a checked rectangular range. Rejects merged/protected cells. Does not save to Files.

params.range: Bounded A1 range, e.g. A1:C20; at most 1000 cells
params.session_id: Required session_id from a fresh read; binds the edit to this document
params.expected_cells: Exact cells matrix from sheets_read_range; checks values AND formulas
params.values: Rectangular matrix of strings, numbers or booleans; dimensions must match range
params.input: values or formulas; formula strings beginning with = require formulas

actions.name: sheets_format_range
actions.description: Format a checked range; rejects merged/protected cells.

params.range: Bounded A1 range, e.g. A1:C20; at most 1000 cells
params.session_id: Required session_id from a fresh read; binds the edit to this document
params.expected_cells: Exact cells matrix from sheets_read_range; checks values AND formulas
params.format: Object: optional bold/italic booleans and font_size (1–200 points), plus number_format string

actions.name: slides_list
actions.description: List live slides with zero-based indices, a title excerpt and text-shape count.

actions.name: slides_read
actions.description: Read text shapes and their paragraph IDs/text on one slide.

actions.name: slides_set_text
actions.description: Replace one checked text-box paragraph. Keeps shape position and other paragraphs; replacement uses the first run’s style, flattening mixed styling in this paragraph.

params.session_id: Required session_id from a fresh read; binds the edit to this document
params.paragraph_id: Exact paragraph id returned by word_read or slides_read
params.expected_text: Exact previous paragraph text; rejects concurrent changes
params.shape_id: Exact shape id returned by slides_read
params.text: Replacement paragraph text, no line breaks

actions.name: slides_format_text
actions.description: Apply basic text formatting to one checked text-box paragraph.

params.session_id: Required session_id from a fresh read; binds the edit to this document
params.paragraph_id: Exact paragraph id returned by word_read or slides_read
params.expected_text: Exact previous paragraph text; rejects concurrent changes
params.shape_id: Exact shape id returned by slides_read
params.format: Object: optional bold/italic booleans and font_size (1–200 points)

notes: The authenticated editor host lives in pantheon-ui. Requires Hub Office support and an operator-configured ONLYOFFICE Document Server; the Document Server JWT secret stays in Hub.
